column1: # Each ISO 3166-1 region's English name, numeric date, time of day, and the
# day its calendar week begins on.
# Derived from Unicode CLDR 44, as ICU 74.2 ships it: for each code in tzdb
# 2026e's iso3166.tab, the region's likely locale (CLDR's likely subtags of
# und-<code>), that locale's best patterns for the skeletons yMd and jm in the
# Gregorian calendar with Latin digits, the region's English display name, and
# its weekData firstDay (the world's, 001, where it has none of its own; an
# A pattern keeps its numeric fields and the ASCII punctuation and spaces
# between them: bidirectional marks are removed, and quoted text, letters and
# every literal after them are dropped.
